description: Election Commission - A member of the Panwila Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of Member
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Panwila Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political alliance. This is an electoral matter directly related to the composition of a local government body, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) as it concerns the status of an elected official under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
